description: Exploring Real world Problems, and building real world solutions to them using AI & Human Creativity
summary: FieldShift is an interactive agricultural decision-support web application that combines real-time and historical NASA Earth observation data (POWER, SMAP, MODIS/Landsat NDVI, and GPM) with local soil profiles and farmer priorities to generate resilient, 3-year (6-season) crop rotation strategies. Farmers worldwide struggle with erratic monsoons, heatwaves, groundwater depletion, and soil degradation caused by continuous monoculture. FieldShift replaces guesswork with an interactive agronomic simulation engine that compares conventional farming against adaptive rotations—helping farmers save up to 40% water, rebuild soil organic carbon, naturally fix soil nitrogen, and stress-test their fields against extreme weather scenarios before planting a single seed.
details:
FieldShift empowers farmers, agronomists, and agricultural analysts to design, simulate, and export adaptive 3-year (6-season + 3 cover-crop window) crop rotation plans tailored to their exact field coordinates.

How It Works:

  1. Location & NASA Telemetry Uplink: Users select their farm via an interactive map, GPS coordinates, or regional presets (such as Pune Semi-Arid Deccan Plateau, Punjab Alluvial, US Corn Belt, or Sahel Dryland). FieldShift fetches live and historical climatology metrics from NASA Earth observation datasets—tracking rainfall patterns, root-zone soil moisture deficits, vegetation heat stress, and drought probability.
  2. Local Soil & Priority Calibration: Farmers input their soil texture (e.g., Black Cotton/Vertisol, Loamy, Sandy, Alluvial), Soil Organic Matter (%), soil pH, irrigation access (Rainfed, Drip, Canal), and weight their priorities across Water Conservation, Soil Carbon Recovery, Climate Resilience, and Net Profit.
  3. Agronomic Rotation Engine & Scoring: The engine evaluates conventional baseline monoculture (e.g., continuous Maize–Wheat) against ranked adaptive rotations (e.g., Hydro-Shield Rotation integrating Finger Millet, Pearl Millet, Lentil, Chickpea, and Sunn Hemp cover crops), computing a 0–100 Field Resilience Score, water savings, nitrogen fixation balance, and soil organic carbon trajectory.
  4. Interactive Crop Swapping & Extreme Weather Stress Simulator: Users can swap any seasonal crop or cover crop and immediately stress-test the 3-year sequence against climate shocks (-30% Monsoon Deficit, +2.5°C Heatwave Spike, or Delayed Monsoon Onset).
  5. Printable 3-Year Adaptation Playbook: Generates a clean, downloadable seasonal sowing, cover-crop, and management calendar.

Tools, Languages & Stack Used: Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, and Lucide Icons, integrating the NASA POWER Climatology API and deployed globally on Cloudflare Pages.
